stem: There is a room of size 2 m × 2 m and of height 3 m. An ant is at one corner of the room on the floor and it wants to reach the opposite corner on the roof. If the ant travels only along the vertical walls, find the minimum distance it has to travel to reach diagonally opposite corner?

assets.alt: A cuboid room 2 m by 2 m by 3 m high. An ant goes from corner A on the floor across one wall to point K on the vertical edge and then across the next wall to the opposite top corner G.
The two walls unfolded flat into a 4 m by 3 m rectangle. The straight red line from A to G is 5 m long and crosses the shared edge at K, 1.5 m up.
